title: Daplow's Chaos Datapack
description: Adds new commands that adds chaos.
body:
### Chaos Datapack
This Datapack adds custom commands to cause chaos in the world.

**Custom Commands**:
- **/function daplowchaos:commands/give_throwing_tnt** - Gives you a throwable TNT.
- **/function daplowchaos:commands/give_fake_golden_apple** - Gives you a Enchanted Golden Apple that gives poison effect.
- **/function daplowchaos:commands/give_midas_pickaxe** - Gives you a Golden Pickaxe with the Midas Touch Enchantment.
- **/function daplowchaos:commands/give_bedrock_pickaxe** - Gives you a Iron Pickaxe with the Bedrock Touch Enchantment.


This is for **Data Pack** 

**YouTube**: [@Daplow111](https://www.youtube.com/@Daplow111)
